events.title: Google Pixel 7 released
events.summary: Google began selling the Google [Pixel] 7 — Tensor G2 and refined camera bar design.
events.about: [Nexus] and [Pixel] phones were Google's pure-[Android] reference hardware for developers. Tensor g2 and refined camera bar design. [AOSP] builds and CTS testing often used [Pixel] devices as the baseline.

narrative.whyChosen: The Google [Pixel] 7 was a flagship Google [Android] reference device.
narrative.whyImportant: [Pixel]/[Nexus] hardware defines the reference [Android] experience for developers.
narrative.problemSolved: [Android] needed first-party reference phones without [OEM] skin fragmentation.

events.title: Python 3.11 released
events.summary: [Python] 3.11 shipped on October 24, 2022 with major CPython speedups, better tracebacks, and exception groups.
events.about: The 'faster CPython' project delivered 10–60% speed gains for many workloads — important for data science, web APIs, and [automation] at scale. Fine-grained error locations (`^` under the exact token) and `TaskGroup` async primitives made production [Python] less painful.

narrative.whyChosen: 3.11 was the performance release that answered critics of [Python]'s speed.
narrative.whyImportant: Faster [bytecode] and specialization kept [Python] competitive for servers and notebooks.
narrative.problemSolved: [CPU]-bound [Python] workloads needed real speedups without rewriting in C or [Rust].

events.title: Next.js 13 introduced the App Router
events.summary: [Vercel] released Next.js 13 on October 25, 2022 with the App Router beta — [React] Server Components, nested layouts, and streaming by default.
events.about: The App Router moved data fetching and rendering to the server by default: `app/` directories, layout.tsx files, and streaming [HTML] replaced many `getServerSideProps` patterns. It shipped as beta in 13.0; the Next.js team recommended production use after App Router reached stable in Next.js 13.4 (May 2023).

narrative.whyChosen: Next.js 13 redefined how [React] apps structure routing and server rendering.
narrative.whyImportant: [React] Server Components went from experiment to mainstream framework default.
narrative.problemSolved: Pages Router scaling issues — layout duplication and client-heavy data loading — needed a new model.
